bug_summary: Context.RoutePattern()がnilレシーバで呼ばれるとnilポインタ参照でパニックする可能性があった
pr_description: `Context.RoutePattern` is always called on a `Context` obtained from the request's own context value, so it is never invoked on a nil receiver in practice. This drops the defensive nil check to keep the method body focused on building the pattern string, and tidies the wording of the doc comment above it.
